title: Demo wallet versus Electrum adapter
description: An adapter lets the same screen ask different backends for wallet operations. Compare the local demo with the Electrum client and trace how context selects/wires it and how JSON-RPC messages travel.
learning_objectives: Explain walletcore boundary, demowalletcore, electrumwalletcore, and websocket transport in plain language.
Trace this.protocol = options.protocol ?? 'ssl'; in `src/wallet-core.ts` and explain the relevant behavior.

State and preserve this limit: Source mismatch: the client constructs a React Native WebSocket but defaults to protocol ssl (and accepts tcp), neither of which is an accepted WebSocket URL scheme. A raw Electrum TCP/TLS endpoint needs a compatible WebSocket gateway or a different transport. The adapter also sends only when the socket is OPEN while calls can be issued immediately, so a first request may be silently dropped. No live Electrum connection was tested.
